mechanics.claim: The ability deals magic damage to enemies hit and slows them by 99% for 0.25 seconds.
mechanics.quote: deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 99% for {{fd|0.25}} seconds

mechanics.claim: Bramble Smash's damage against monsters is increased by the Bonus Monster Damage amount, capped at 9999 total health-ratio damage against non-champions.
mechanics.quote: ''Bramble Smash's'' damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at 9999 against non-champions.

mechanics.claim: Enemies near Maokai are additionally stunned and knocked back, separate from the main slow effect.
mechanics.quote: Enemies near '''Maokai''' are also {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds and {{tip|airborne|knocked back}} up to 300 units based on their proximity to him.

mechanics.claim: Maokai is locked out of actions for an additional 0.075 seconds after the cast time ends.
mechanics.quote: '''Maokai''' remains locked out from the cast time for another {{fd|0.075}} seconds after it.
